heroTagline: A private, offline-first family health companion. No account, no cloud, no server — your health data never leaves your device.

features.title: Profiles for the whole family
features.body: Track vitals, goals and medications per person.

features.title: Vitals & trends
features.body: Log weight, blood pressure and glucose; view trends against healthy ranges.

features.title: Goals with projected ETA
features.body: Set targets and get realistic estimates from your own readings.

features.title: Gentle reminders
features.body: On-device notifications for water, tasks, medications and schedules.

features.title: Medical documents
features.body: Encrypted vault for prescriptions, lab reports and insurance cards.

features.title: Emergency ICE card
features.body: Quick-access medical card with blood group, conditions and allergies.

features.title: LAN sync
features.body: Sync desktop and mobile directly over your own Wi-Fi — nothing over the internet.

privacyNote.title: No backend. No telemetry.
privacyNote.body: All data lives in a local SQLite database and an encrypted vault on your own machine. myHealth can't phone home — there's nowhere for it to call. The only network use is receive-only: pulling signed public reference content.
